apps.name: S2 Command
apps.summary: Most listed features are built and tested; the Make.com agent and Overview agent are not reachable, and several screens have no tests.

apps.name: LeadSifter
apps.summary: Nearly all modules are built and tested; missing are ACH or wire collection, extra roles, wet-ink signing, dedicated email IP pools, plan-gated limits and Schedule K-1 generation.

apps.name: InboxHelm
apps.summary: Nearly everything is built and live; gaps are the DashComm status feed, Web Push and Obsidian saving on web. Passkey and Texts pairing click-throughs are unverified, so this is a little generous.

apps.name: ScopeTask
apps.summary: Nearly every ticket is built and tested; gaps are a CI-enforced speed budget for all screens, a ClickUp import not yet proven live, and Open in Claude only copying the request.

apps.name: Tabor
apps.summary: Most of the app is built and tested; gaps are the voice coach switched off, Premium never tried with a real purchase, partial coaching and no web push notifications.

apps.name: FerretBooks
apps.summary: Nearly every spec item is built and tested; gaps are an unverified cash versus accrual toggle, stronger-model escalation routing and a Plaid sandbox seed script.

apps.name: Famtinerary
apps.summary: Nearly all built and tested; missing are row level security and the nightly drive precompute, and error tracking, analytics and weather are built but not switched on in production.

apps.name: ThriveMapper_3.0
apps.summary: Core goals, energy, journal, AI coach, templates and role dashboards are built; Google and Apple sign-in and password reset are missing, and there are no automated tests.

apps.name: WardenKey
apps.summary: Core vault, sync, extension and host are built; missing are one-time-code storage, Chrome and generic CSV import, sign-up flows, attachments, a global hotkey and a light theme.

apps.name: GoHighLevel Bridge
apps.summary: Nearly everything described is built and wired; the token refresh on expiry has no test.

apps.name: Fal.ai Bridge
apps.summary: Both endpoints, auth, retries and deploy config are in place; there are no automated tests.

apps.name: Frost FM
apps.summary: Every v0.1.0 item is built and wired in; only the player queue prefetch and keyboard shortcuts lack tests.

apps.name: Automate With Brandon
apps.summary: Core site, playbook, resources, redirects and tracking are live; the workbook email capture only redirects. Small spec of 9 items.
